story: In one minute a visitor understands that I am an AI engineer, sees a real run, and can reach the architecture of a project.

scenes.proof: Name, role, three evidence-backed results, a demo button and a WhatsApp button, all as HTML text
scenes.reducedMotion: Same hero. The background is a single rendered frame, or the level 1 layers
scenes.mobile: Same HTML. Portrait screens keep the level 1 background
scenes.focus: Skip link first, then the header, then the first call to action

scenes.proof: The project card list and the symbol object of the active project, chosen by scroll position
scenes.reducedMotion: No flight: the camera jumps to the active project's station and stops
scenes.mobile: Project cards in the page. No canvas on portrait screens
scenes.focus: Links inside the cards, in page order. The canvas never takes focus

scenes.proof: Choosing a project card opens its case page, and the camera holds at that project
scenes.focus: The case heading receives focus after navigation

scenes.proof: Problem, decisions with the rejected option, measured results, failure gallery and the diagram with its text list, in a fixed order
scenes.reducedMotion: The diagram walkthrough changes scenes with no travelling token
scenes.mobile: Sections stacked. Side index hidden on narrow screens
scenes.focus: Case heading first, then the sections in order

scenes.proof: The side index lists all eight projects and marks the open one
scenes.mobile: The index is not shown on narrow screens; the home project list is the way between projects
scenes.focus: Index links in order, current project marked with aria-current

scenes.proof: WhatsApp button, phone, e-mail, LinkedIn and GitHub, in a normal section
Stack status, budget left, and the model, tokens, latency and cost of each step of a real run
scenes.reducedMotion: The scene events are not sent; the run log shows the same numbers
scenes.mobile: Status, budget and log stacked; start button above the accounts
scenes.focus: Start button, then the account list, then the log
